newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index down in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index down in lower volume.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius index eased 0.29 points to 322.03 in lower volume on Friday, reflecting an absence of good sentiment across the market, brokers said.
Turnover was provisionally posted at 7.98 million rupees on 440,152 shares from 11.21 million rupees on 420,572 shares on Wednesday.

Moving share prices were mostly down in thin margins on Friday and stocks of Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) and Fincorp Investment had unexpected reactions to their profit increases reported on Thursday.

MCB was unchanged at 73 rupees on 11,936 shares and Fincorp Investment fell 1.50 rupees to 72 rupees on 1,400 shares after posting pre-tax profit increases of 21 percent and 19 percent respectively for the financial year ending 30 June 1996.
"If the market is reacting in such a manner to profit increases from a blue chip company like MCB, it must be that favourable general sentiment is not here," an analyst said.
The analyst blamed the lack of market confidence on the prolonged uncertainty surrounding the Mauritian government.
British American Insurance lost 10 cents to 7.20 rupees on 11,300 shares while State Bank of Mauritius was stable at 8.50 rupees on 167,450 shares.

Mauritius Breweries was unchanged at 125 rupees on 2,531 shares. Mauritius Oil Refineries lost 20 cents to 8.20 rupees on 10,780 shares but Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers jumped 1.40 rupees to 47.90 rupees on 120 shares.
General Investment Development Company (ordinary) was 20 cents down to 6.0 rupees on 20,815 shares. Mauritius Development Investment Trust remained at 7.50 rupees on 42,500 shares.
National Investment Trust (NIT) fell by 60 cents to 11.80 rupees on 1,450 shares while United Docks was stable at 39.80 rupees on 5,636 shares.
In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert was one rupee higher to 35.10 on 1,712 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers was down 50 cents to 91.50 rupees on 8,619 shares while Ireland Blyth eased 10 cents to 12.90 rupees on 100 shares.
Commerce-based Courts (Mauritius) was unchanged at 3.80 rupees on 31,000 shares and Happy World Foods added 10 cents to 14 rupees on 7,390 shares.
New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 28 rupees on 85,447 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was 50 cents up to 51 rupees on 1,554 shares.
